race.comment: LIMOSA (4) did well last time to finish fourth over 1700m at Warrnambool. Won't be bothered by this longer journey, should be at peak fitness now, draws well and has Linda Meech. ALLYOUWANADOISROCK (7) accounted for a maiden field over 1600m at Bairnsdale last start, winning by half-a-length. Sparingly raced and looks to have a little more upside than most here. JUST SWIFT (9) showed good speed and fought on for third over 2200m at Donald last time. Has been in solid form this campaign with a win and four minor placings from eight starts. and draws to play a key role. PHANTOM'S CHASE (5) ran his best race since a freshen last time out when second, beaten 3/4 of a length, a repeat of which would have him in the mix. Just has to overcome the tricky wide gate. BELLSYM (13) returned in great style last time out, which he'll be better for and looks suited back up to this trip from a nice gate.
